title: RetryFanOutTasks.v1
description: Retry FAILED tasks of a job (FAILED -> PENDING) when ms-backfill-reconciler resumes a campaign (DEC-24). Operators use POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}/dead-tasks:retry, which runs the same use case without a message.
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.4 catalog CMD-06; RF-107, RF-085; US-08.2.2. Producer: ms-backfill-reconciler. Consumers: ms-publish-fanout. Channel: SQS {cell}-ms-publish-fanout-commands. Ordering/partition key: jobId. Idempotency key: jobId + requestId. Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: additive within v1 (DISENO 4.2). dataClass: OPERATIONAL (DISENO 4.4). Stays inside its cell; operational metadata only (ids, counters, hashes). Response event(s): EngagementVersionInspected.v1, FanOutTaskDeadLettered.v1.

requestId.description: Retry request id (idempotency key with jobId); stored as fanout_job.lastRetryRequestId. The operator API uses its Idempotency-Key as requestId (DEC-35).

failureReasons.description: Which FAILED tasks to retry, by failureReason; absent = all FAILED tasks.

max.description: Maximum number of tasks to move FAILED -> PENDING.
